fields.Appearance: Colorfully dressed, expressive, and constantly counting with ring-covered fingers.
fields.Backstory: A trader built a route between villages ignored by large commercial houses.
fields.Goals: Establish a permanent market and prevent a monopoly from absorbing the route.

fields.Appearance: Neat, approachable, and positioned behind spectacles chosen to appear trustworthy.
fields.Backstory: A shopkeeper inherited a store whose cellar contains goods absent from every ledger.
fields.Goals: Identify the goods' owner and restore the business without attracting criminal attention.

fields.Appearance: Road-worn and alert, wearing layered dust cloths and a caravan company's brass badge.
fields.Backstory: A caravan worker survived an ambush by negotiating with the attackers instead of fighting.
fields.Goals: Make the route safer and discover who supplied the bandits with the schedule.

fields.Appearance: Well-fed, heavily perfumed, and accompanied by subtle signs of recent wealth.
fields.Backstory: A former dock laborer became a supplier through excellent timing and genuine generosity.
fields.Goals: Enter respectable society without abandoning the workers who enabled that rise.

fields.Appearance: Reserved, immaculately dressed, and carrying sample cases secured by several locks.
fields.Backstory: A foreign factor was stranded when war severed every connection to the parent company.
fields.Goals: Build local alliances, protect employees, and decide whether loyalty to the company still matters.
